capabilities: chat with Claude inside Obsidian on desktop and mobile
read, search, list, create, and update vault notes through Claude tools
pin additional notes to the chat context with a fuzzy file picker
approve or reject every write and Bash action before it runs
run a Mac relay backend that bills usage to a Claude subscription
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes extensive security and privacy disclosures (network use, vault enumeration, YOLO auto-approve risk) and notes the relay backend does not enforce the Private folders boundary.
intentEvidence: Existing Claude integrations for Obsidian (such as Claudian) embed the Claude Code CLI as a child process, which makes them desktop-only
motivation: The author wanted Claude with agentic vault access working on mobile, so it calls the Anthropic Messages API directly or routes through a Mac relay instead of embedding the CLI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and existing Claude integrations are desktop-only because they spawn the Claude Code CLI, which mobile Obsidian cannot run.

relations.evidence: Existing Claude integrations for Obsidian (such as Claudian) embed the Claude Code CLI as a child process
It wraps the Claude Agent SDK with your vault as the working directory

requires.name: Claude Code and Node 18+ on a Mac (relay backend)

summary: AI chat with Claude that reads, searches, creates, and updates vault notes, running via the Anthropic API or a self-hosted Mac relay.
